watchlist.title: Extinction Resource Guide, Best Resource Locations, Ark Survival Ascended
watchlist.description:
Resources are the cornerstone of survival in every Ark. In this guide, I’ll show you the best locations for every crucial resource you’ll need to thrive on Extinction. Whether you’re looking for basics like stone and flint, or rare materials like black pearls and corrupted wood, this video has got you covered!

Resources Covered in This Guide:
0:00-0:14 Intro
0:15-0:32 Oil
0:33-0:54 Organic Polymer/Polymer/Corrupted Nodules
0:53: 1:10 Honey
1:11-1:39 Cementing Paste & Bio Toxin
1:40-1:54 Rare Mushrooms/Rare Flowers & Silk
1:55-2:13 Sap     
2:14-2:46 Obsidian & Black Pearls
2:47-3:05 Condensed Gas/Sulfur
3:06-3:26 Green Gems/Crystalized Sap
3:27-3:42 Silicate & Silicia Pearls
3:43-4:06 Metal & Scrap Metal
4:07-4:26: Crystal
4:27-4:48: Element & Element Dust: 
4:49-5:58: Basic Resources &Final Great Locations

Special Note: Most resources can be passively produced by Gachas, but some (like Honey, Rare Flowers, Rare Mushrooms, Cementing Paste, and Chitin) require manual collection.

Every map brings new challenges, and Extinction is no exception. Which resource has given you the most trouble on this map? Let me know in the comments! Or, if you have a tip, share it to help your fellow survivors.

If you enjoyed this guide, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more in-depth ARK content.

#ark #arksurvival #arksurvivalascended

watchlist.description:
Welcome to this comprehensive Ark: Survival Ascended Aberration Resource Location guide! In this walkthrough, we will cover everything you need to know to progress in this challenging environment of ASA Aberration. I will be showing you how to find resources on Aberration. We will be looking at: 

Metal locations, Crystal locations, gem locations, obsidian locations, element ore locations, cementing paste location, silica pearl locations, oil locations, rare flower locations, rare mushroom locations, bio toxin locations, mushrooms locations, giant bee honey locations and more. 

If you enjoyed this guide or found it helpful then I would really appreciate it if you considered subscribing if you are not already, leaving a like, and leaving a comment down below letting me know what you enjoyed about the video or if you learned something new.

Chapters Section: 
Intro: 0:00-0:22
Metal: 0:23-4:39
Obsidian: 4:40-5:25
Silica Pearls: 5:26-8:45
Gems/Crystal: 8:46-11:04
Black Pearls: 11:05-11:16
Bio Toxin: 11:17-12:37
Rare Mushrooms & Rare Flowers: 12:38-13:39 
Cementing paste: 13:40-15:11
Chitin/Keratin: 15:12-15:46
Organic Polymer: 15:47-16:41
Oil: 16:42-17:49
Congealed Gas Balls 17:50-18:38
Element Ore: 18:39-19:01
Plant Species Z seed: 19:02-20:06
Giant Bee Honey: 20:07-22:00

Earthquake Drops: https://ark.fandom.com/wiki/Earthquake_(Aberration)

Become A Member: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChNE0dyDoDPfnbQFrw6e99A/join

Outro: Xenogenesis by TheFatRat

#ark #arksurvival #arksurvivalevolved #arksurvivalascended
